function: function (p. 6): a complex-valued CNN (IFFT-C2VNN) estimates target AoA, AoD, ToA and Doppler from CSI at a passive bistatic radar; this is target sensing, not beams, waveforms or resources.
notes: Reason function. p. 6: "IFFT-C2VNN leverages complex-valued convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to directly predict the sensing parameters from the estimated CSI". p. 4: "the communication function operates unchanged, without being disrupted or sacrificed, and the passive radar opportunistically performs sensing by reusing the BS downlink waveform", and the design "keeps the pilot structure, frame format, scheduling, and precoding unchanged". The learned network estimates target parameters (angles, delay, Doppler) at a passive radar receiver, which is close to the excluded localization and direction-of-arrival functions. The channel itself is estimated by classical LS (p. 4, eq. 8), and no beam, waveform or resource is learned. The only metrics are sensing errors (ToA RMSE, AoA and AoD MSE against the CRB, speed MAE, pp. 12-14). The second proposed method, PARAMING, is not learned. Borderline, for the reviewer to confirm: the system does communicate (the BS serves UEs), while the exclusion example names only sensing in a system that does not communicate. I followed the definition of area 5 (beams, waveforms, resources), which this method does not meet. The PDF is arXiv:2509.02137v2; its p. 1 header gives the same title, 'High-Resolution Sensing in Communication-Centric ISAC: Deep Learning and Parametric Methods', as accepted in IEEE JSAC 2025.
